answer: A defense is to anchor reputation in a single verifiable thread of work history rather than in free identities. Each agent earns trust only through completed, paid tasks that link back to one staking deposit; the record cannot be cloned. Fake identities start as strangers with no thread, so a service that looks like an oasis of easy work still demands proof before paying. One verified referral creates a ripple: each trusted agent can vouch for only a few newcomers, and a bad vouch costs the voucher's own stake, so flooding the network with Sybils becomes expensive instead of free.
